{{Quote|Seeg, the Rodian, and I staged a fistfight in one of the larger clubs in the capital city. The little lizard missed a cue and broke my nose&hellip; I threw him over the bar, but it was an 'honest' accident. The stunt worked&mdash;when we were released from the local jail the next morning, Tefilous informed us that our popularity on Ord Dorlass had increased by six points.|Siro Simito, report on the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade|<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
A '''nightclub''' was located in the [[Unidentified capital city (Ord Dorlass)|capital city]] of<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE Dorlass">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord Dorlass}}</ref> [[Ord Dorlass]]. One of the larger such venues in the [[City/Legends|city]], it featured a bar. During a [[Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade]] [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] race held during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Racer/Legends|racers]] [[Siro Simito]] and [[Seeg]] staged a fistfight in nightclub in order to boost their popularity.<ref name="CRO" />
